description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to message output and publishing within the WPEFramework project. It includes abstract interfaces for publishing messages, and concrete classes for outputting messages to console, syslog, files, JSON formatted logs, UDP, and WebSocket connections. It also defines a JSON data structure for exporting message metadata.
